{{Top|leg}}
'''Shock fields''' were electrical barriers used for security purposes; anyone who came into contact with a shock field would receive an electric shock. Shock fields were used in conjunction with defense [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] to defend public buildings on [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] throneworld [[Byss/Legends|Byss]].<ref name="DESB">''[[Dark Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref> Reverse-polarity shock fields were used to get rid of [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]] at the [[Ord Mynock Freeport]] on [[Ord Mynock/Legends|Ord Mynock]].<ref name="LAA">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref> Additionally, contact shock fields were used in [[Universal Energy Cage]]s to shock [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] anytime the cage was damaged in the event the prisoner attempted to escape.<ref name="EotJ">{{DoD|Echoes of the Jedi}}</ref><ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref>
